hook.text: She delivered the best results on the team. At promotion time, leadership said they didn't know her work.

buildup.text: Doing great work is necessary but not sufficient. Work that nobody sees doesn't earn recognition.

discovery.text: Visibility is not bragging. It's ensuring the right people understand your contributions and their impact.

twist.text: Document wins and share them as team updates, not personal boasts. 'Our team shipped X' credits everyone.

climax.text: Send brief monthly updates to your manager and skip-level. Three bullets: done, impact, next.

punchline.text: If they don't know, it didn't happen. Make it visible.

quiz.question: Why is visibility important for career advancement?
options: It proves you work longer hours than colleagues
Great work that nobody sees doesn't earn recognition
Managers always track all contributions automatically
